45: “Have done laughing!” said the corporal. “And take the body away. Why have you put the nasty thing by the hut?”

40: “Drink, lads! I’ll stand you a pail!” said Luke. “I’ll bring it myself from the village.”

30: “Well, Lukáshka, whatever you do you must stand a pail of vodka for the lads,” said the corporal gaily.

25: “And supposing a jackal tears him? Would that be well?” remarked another Cossack.

17: “Mósev, I’ll go home,” said Lukáshka, evidently forgetting his vexation and wishing to get some advantage out of having to give a present to his superior.
15: “It’ll do to fetch firewood in,” said one of the Cossacks.

6: “That would make it easier for him to swim,” said some one.

2: “Must have been a smart one to offer himself before the others; a regular brave!” said Lukáshka mockingly, shivering as he wrung out his clothes that had got wet on the bank.
0: “Where have our fellows gone to search? I expect the rest of them are on the other bank. If this one had not been a scout he would not have swum that way. Why else should he swim alone?” said a third.
